title: Disturbance-Observer-Based Control and Related Methods—An Overview
locator: Review of disturbance-observer architecture, Q-filter realizability, noise rejection and cutoff-frequency trade-offs
notes: Review discusses low-pass Q-filter design, properness relative to the nominal plant inverse, and the trade-off among disturbance attenuation, model uncertainty, control effort and measurement noise. DOB design must also consider minimum-phase assumptions and robust stability; do not copy a cutoff frequency from an unrelated plant.
